content_sections.heading: About Mahayogi Gorakhnath University
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur is a multidisciplinary university on a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur, with its office at Arogya Dham, Balapar Road, Sonbarsa, Gorakhpur-273007. It offers higher education in Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Health and Life Science, Engineering and Technology, Allied and Healthcare, and Management and Commerce. The campus is also home to an upcoming multi-specialty hospital with 1,800 beds, along with two functional multispecialty hospitals in Gorakhpur: Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (650+ beds) and Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (300+ beds).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may send their detailed resume along with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 05th December, 2026. The notice names no postal address and no application form. Email address: [email protected] Subject of email: Application for Assistant Security Officer Attach: detailed resume and supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Assistant Security Officer, with 02 vacancies. The notice prints no category-wise break-up of the vacancies. Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 03 years of relevant experience in security operations in a University, Hospital, Government or Corporate organization. Experience in monitoring CCTV systems and maintaining security-related records. Ability to supervise security guards, monitor their attendance and ensure proper duty allocation. Good communication, coordination and team management skills. Ability to maintain discipline and ensure effective implementation of security instructions. Experience in a supervisory role in the security department of a hospital, university or large institution. Knowledge of fire safety procedures, disaster management and emergency response protocols. Experience in liaison with the Police Department and other law-enforcement agencies. Basic knowledge of official drafting and report writing related to security matters. Good leadership and interpersonal skills to manage and coordinate the security team effectively. Salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience as per University rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice does not describe how candidates are shortlisted or what the interview covers.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Security Officer posts has MGUG advertised?
faq.answer: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur has advertised 02 posts of Assistant Security Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGUG Assistant Security Officer post?
faq.answer: The resume must be sent by email on or before 05th December, 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MGUG Assistant Security Officer?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution is required, along with minimum 03 years of relevant experience in security operations in a University, Hospital, Government or Corporate organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the MGUG Assistant Security Officer?
faq.answer: The notice states that salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience as per University rules. No amount is printed.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for MGUG Assistant Security Officer?
faq.answer: Send your detailed resume along with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 05th December, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What subject should I write in the application email?
faq.answer: The subject of the email should be "Application for Assistant Security Officer".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for MGUG Assistant Security Officer?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which skills are desirable for the MGUG Assistant Security Officer post?
faq.answer: Desirable skills include supervisory experience in the security department of a hospital, university or large institution, knowledge of fire safety, disaster management and emergency response, experience in liaison with the Police Department and law-enforcement agencies, and basic official drafting and report writing.

faq.question: Q9. Can MGUG withdraw the advertisement or leave posts unfilled?
faq.answer: Yes. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts for any reason, and to withdraw the advertisement partly or wholly at any time without assigning any reason.
